meta.title: Breadegg®
meta.description: We turn ideas into intelligent products. AI, software and design, built as one thing. From Madeira, Portugal.

hero.title: We build things impossible to ignore.

manifesto.body: Most companies buy their future in pieces. A brand from one place. A website from another. Software from a third. And an AI tool nobody opens. Four invoices, four roadmaps, and nothing that fits together.
manifesto.close: We build the whole thing. Because the whole thing is the point.

cases.title: Results, not deliverables.
cases.note: Anyone can show a screenshot. These are the numbers that changed.

madeira.title: Built on an island in the Atlantic.
madeira.body: Madeira is a small market that behaves like a laboratory. Hotels, rentals, restaurants and agencies, dense enough that an idea can be tested in weeks instead of quarters. What holds up here, we take to the mainland.
madeira.close: Distance stopped mattering a while ago. The work happens where the problem is.

contact.title: Bring us a problem.
contact.body: Not a spec, not a feature list. The thing that is costing you time or money. If we're not the right people for it, we'll say so and point you somewhere better.

form.name: Name
form.success: Got it. You'll hear from us within a day.
form.error: That didn't send. Email us directly and we'll pick it up.
